definitions.initialAttempt: First shot/free throw for First Team Score; first field-goal attempt for field-goal-only.
definitions.offensiveRebound: Explicit player-credited offensive rebound before the selected team opening score; team/dead-ball rebounds remain separate.
definitions.rebounderScoredNext: Same identified rebounder made the next recorded scoring attempt before the selected team opening score. Unknown or absent next attempts remain unavailable.
definitions.putback: Printed Putback or Tip Layup/Dunk/Shot description; direct second-chance finish shown separately, without inferring possession or defender.
